title: Split remaining WebView god-file facades
summary: Split all active implementation files above 1,000 lines into responsibility-focused WebView, Tauri, Python, and PowerShell modules while retaining their public facades and backend authority boundaries.
reason: Oversized facades, policy modules, registries, contract catalogs, and pipeline scripts made troubleshooting and safe review difficult; the repository goal requires every active implementation file to remain at or below 1,000 lines.
behavior_before: Multiple WebView, Tauri, Python, and PowerShell implementation files exceeded 1,000 lines and combined unrelated projection, rendering, command, lifecycle, persistence, and evidence responsibilities.
behavior_after: Public exports, DOM IDs, routes, payloads, strict confirmations, and backend-owned mutation policy remain in place, while facades compose focused dependency-ordered children and no active implementation file exceeds 1,000 lines.
manual_validation: Active implementation line-count scan: passed; zero files above 1,000 lines.
Dynamic HDR detection check: failed on pre-existing publish_completion dynamic_hdr textual contract mismatch; runtime detection assertions before it passed.
Focused Python suites for TDARR, autonomy diagnostics, network, repair dry-run, rerun results/preview, completed/failure policy, config, settings wizard, route map, registries, and preflight: passed.
PowerShell EncodeFlag, EncoderCapability, DynamicHdrTooling, MultiVideoTopology, Rerun PlanOnly/NestedConfig/CooperativeStop, and ContractSchema checks: passed.
PowerShell parser across 86 changed/untracked scripts: passed.
Repair reconcile apply suite: 11 passed, 5 command-journal count assertions failed (three entries observed versus one expected).
Sample validation static assertion: failed because legacy test still expects extracted route text in app.js; 9 API tests passed.
Settings/Launch browser smoke from WebView split: passed.
Strict change validation: worktree coverage gaps cleared; global validation remains failed by unrelated malformed/incomplete packets MP-CHANGE-2026-0707-001, -0710-007, and -0710-022.
Tauri launch smoke: shell launched and rendered; shutdown phase failed because backend close-readiness rejected shutdown.
node --check across 167 changed/untracked JavaScript files: passed.
rollback_plan: Restore each facade and its extracted children together from the pre-change revision, restore the prior production/test load order, regenerate summaries, and rerun the focused WebView, Tauri, Python, and PowerShell validation suites.
